lines: He walked across the desert for days, with no food and no shelter, until he reached the land of Madyan.
At the well, shepherds crowded around the water. And standing apart, he saw two women holding back their flock.
He asked them what was wrong. They said: we cannot water our sheep until the shepherds leave. And our father is a very old man.
So Musa watered their flock for them. Then he went back to the shade of a tree. Exhausted. Hungry. A stranger with nothing.
And he made a dua: "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."
And Allah answered him almost at once. Their father invited him in, heard his story, and told him: "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."
He gave Musa work, a home, and his daughter in marriage. And Musa stayed in Madyan for years.
